input.title: Let admins export the users table as CSV
input.body:
Problem: admins copy rows by hand from /admin/users into spreadsheets. In the last 30 days 14 support messages asked for a user list export, one saying "I paste 300 rows into Sheets every Monday."
User: an admin of a SaaS built on this starter.
Fit: extends the admin dashboard (admin-dashboard), admin role only.
Duplicate: no export exists today.
Acceptance: an Export CSV button on /admin/users downloads id, name, email, role, banned, created date for the current filter; a non-admin gets 403; zero users yields a header-only file.
Non-goals: no scheduled exports, no other tables.
Metric: 30% of admin sessions that open the users table use export within a month, measured with an analytics event.
UI states: button disabled and spinner while loading; toast on error; empty table exports header only.
Data: read only, no schema change.
Roles: admin only, enforced in the admin tRPC router.
i18n and analytics: strings in en and zh; event admin_users_exported.
Errors: tagged ExportFailedError mapped to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.
Non-negotiables: Effect Schema for the filter input, no Zod, no process.env.

note: UI feature with no empty, loading or error states. 2026-10-25 spec: no problem is stated, so problem is flagged.

input.title: Add a notifications panel to the dashboard
input.body: Users should see a bell icon in the dashboard header that opens a panel listing recent notifications such as upload finished or account changes. Show the newest first and let people click one to open the related page.

note: Backend-only feature; ui_states should be n/a, not flagged.

input.title: Rate limit the upload endpoint
input.body:
Problem: one signed-in user can post unlimited files to /api/upload-file and fill the R2 bucket.
User: the developer running the SaaS, and honest end users who suffer when the bucket fills.
Acceptance: more than 20 uploads per user per hour returns 429 with a retry-after header; limits stored in D1 or KV; the limit is a constant in one file.
Non-goals: no per-plan limits, no admin override.
Metric: zero days where one user exceeds 5% of daily upload volume.
No UI change.
Errors: RateLimitedError tagged and mapped to TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.
Non-negotiables: Effect, Effect Schema, Workers bindings only.

note: Settings page with a plausible UI but no data or roles detail. 2026-10-25 spec: no problem is stated, so problem is flagged.

input.title: Profile settings page
input.body: Add /dashboard/settings where a signed-in user can change their display name and choose light, dark or system theme. Save on submit and show a success message. Should look like the rest of the dashboard.

note: Admin action; roles and errors matter. 2026-10-25 spec: problem is hedged ('may stay alive') with no observed failure, so problem is flagged.

input.title: Admins can force-sign-out a user
input.body: When we ban someone their session may stay alive for hours. Add a Sign out everywhere button on a user row in /admin/users that revokes all of that user's sessions. Admin role only. If the user is already signed out, show a message instead of failing. Acceptance: after the click, the user's next request redirects to login. Log an analytics event. Strings in en and zh. Extends the existing ban flow.

note: Needs a table; data and seed fixtures must be addressed. 2026-10-25 spec: problem ('users want') has no evidence, so problem is flagged.

input.title: Let users save files into folders
input.body: Users want to group uploads into named folders. Add a folders table (id, userId, name, createdAt) and a nullable folderId on the uploads record. The dashboard shows folders as a left list; dragging a file onto one moves it. Users only see their own folders. Acceptance: create, rename, delete folder; deleting moves files to Unfiled. Success: median user with 10+ files has at least one folder after a month.

note: Small analytics event; mostly complete.

input.title: Track sign-up completion
input.body: Problem: we see page views of /sign-up but not how many people finish. User: the developer who forks the starter and reads the admin overview. Add an event sign_up_completed fired on the server after Better Auth creates the account, through app/repositories/analytics.ts. Acceptance: one row per new account; none on validation failure; appears in the admin overview count. Non-goals: no funnel UI, no client-side tracking. Metric: event count within 1% of new user rows over a week. No UI change. Roles: none, server side. Errors: a failed event write must not fail sign-up; log and continue. Non-negotiables: Effect, no process.env.

note: A bare idea with no ticket. 2026-10-25 spec: a guessable user gives user: guess and amend; unchanged.
A very long ticket whose key gap is buried; the auditor must read all of it. 2026-10-25 spec: 'many customers' and 'support emails' give no count or quote, so problem is flagged.
